scope: Original base game standard core + applicable linked Living FAQ; optional modules excluded

questions.question: When using a beginner Spirit’s Power Progression, what must be done during setup with the Minor and Major cards listed on that Progression? Should they stay in the shared shuffled decks to be drawn normally by other gains?
Do the normal cascade and one-Presence-per-Spirit destruction rules apply to Blight placed during setup, or only to Blight added after setup?

In the first ordinary turn after standard setup, the Ravage Action Space has no Invader Card. Do Invaders Ravage anyway or draw a card for Ravage, or is that action omitted? What is the general rule for an empty Invader Action Space?

Three Fear Cards were earned in a known order. During the Fear step, may players inspect all three before resolving the first? In which order are they resolved, and where does each card go once resolved?

A normal Power deals 3 Damage in a land with a healthy Town and City. Must players finish destroying one chosen Invader before assigning Damage to the other, or may they assign 1 to the Town and 2 to the City so both survive?

An instruction explicitly downgrades two Invaders simultaneously. May one City be selected twice, first becoming a Town and then an Explorer, or must the pieces be selected before either replacement? Contrast two separate players’ legal Trade Suffers III actions.

Assume two Ravage Cards will be resolved in sequence. A land matching the second card is empty when the Ravage step begins, but a triggered effect during the first card moves an Invader there before the second card begins. Does that land Ravage from the second card, or was eligibility locked for the whole step?
When Ocean exchanges already Drowned Invaders for Energy, does it value their modified current Health, or their printed Health? Do temporary and permanent Health modifiers change that exchange value?

Dissolve the Bonds of Kinship must Push three Explorers, and three distinct adjacent legal destination lands are available. May all three be sent to one land, or must they be split? If only two legal destination lands are available, what distribution restriction remains?

Words of Warning has resolved on a land that will Ravage. Do its Dahan deal their one Ravage attack simultaneously with the Invaders, or only surviving Dahan after Invader Damage? Can a Dahan destroyed by that same simultaneous Damage still contribute its Ravage Damage?

Entwined Power’s target Spirit draws four cards for its gain and keeps one. For the using Spirit’s subsequent gain, does that Spirit draw a fresh set of four, or select from the three cards the target did not keep? In solo, are the two cards gained through this base effect selected from one initial draw or two?
When a Power removes Blight from the island, does the token go back to the box or to the currently face-up Blight Card/Invader Board pool? Does a Blighted Island card receive removed Blight too?
Infinite Vitality is active in its target land. A later effect would add Blight there. Where does that Blight token go, and do the ordinary Presence destruction and cascade from adding it occur?

Blazing Renewal resolves on Spirit B, which has two destroyed Presence. A legal single destination within Range 2 of the using Spirit A’s Presence is available. Can it restore those destroyed disks despite the ordinary Add Presence restriction, and are they returned to the tracks or placed on the island?
When Vengeance of the Dead meets its threshold, may its triggered Damage be dealt to Invaders in a land adjacent to the target, and does that change the card’s target land?
For Song of Sanctity, what happens if the target land contains an Explorer, and what happens if it contains none? May the player select the Blight-removal branch while Explorers are present?

With Entwined Power’s threshold met, can only the target Spirit gift a card to the using Spirit, or may each gift one to the other? May a gifted card come from cards in play or personal discard instead of hand, and is either gift mandatory?
In a standard two-Spirit game with balanced Island Boards, must the boards use only the illustrated bottom-to-bottom layout, or may players join them in another arrangement that fits?
If Powerstorm grants a Spirit a Repeat of a Power Card that it already paid to play, must that Spirit pay the card’s Energy cost again to use that Repeat?
